blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers on tap, award-winning Wagyu smash burgers, sourdough pizzas, barbecue, and other food offerings at two locations. The brewery hosts special events such as the Harvest Gathering featuring estate-grown ingredients and live music. They offer beer clubs with quarterly bottle releases and members-only events, with options for taproom pickup or California shipping.
extraNote: Beer shipping available within California only · $15 flat rate shipping under $50, $25 for $50-$200, free over $200 · Beer ships twice per week, orders ship Monday or Thursday · No returns or exchanges on beer; damaged items handled case-by-case · Merchandise returns accepted within 30 days if unused and in original condition · Orders may be picked up at Santa Barbara or Carpinteria taprooms with valid ID · Santa Barbara taproom at 406 E Haley Suite #3 or Carpinteria taproom at 720 Linden Ave, Carpinteria, CA 93103
